A '''tracomp''' was a device that allowed its user to determine his or her location while on a [[Planet/Legends|planetary body]] by detecting nearby [[Navigation buoy/Legends|navigational beacons]] and the planet's axial and magnetic poles. It could be part of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensor array]] or used as a portable device<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>. Some [[thermal suit]]s and mining uniforms came with tracomps built into their sleeves.
